requirements.name: Site Explorer
requirements.description: Read-only inventory of site, plugin, theme, CPT, taxonomy, option, meta and native Ability availability with capability provenance; never enumerate arbitrary private storage.
requirements.negative_case: unknown plugin or stale inventory denies write

requirements.name: Universal Form Bridge
requirements.description: Build chat-facing forms from certified typed descriptors for options, post/term/user meta, CPTs, relationships and approved custom adapters; no arbitrary SQL.
requirements.negative_case: unknown dynamic field defaults to read-only

requirements.name: Smart Autocomplete
requirements.description: Resolve terms, posts, linked records and select options by exact scoped queries with paging, language and cardinality.
requirements.negative_case: cross-tenant suggestion forbidden

requirements.name: Dependency-aware Forms
requirements.description: Apply declarative conditional visibility, validation and required-if constraints without executing untrusted plugin expressions.
requirements.negative_case: hidden-field injection rejected

requirements.name: Visual Diff and Preview
requirements.description: Render redacted before/after values, post-render preview and estimated side effects bound to exact object revision.
requirements.negative_case: preview must not mutate or claim publication

requirements.name: Secure Credentials Center
requirements.description: Collect API keys through short-lived first-party HTTPS secret handoff with origin binding and no chat/MCP plaintext; verify, rotate and revoke.
requirements.negative_case: secret must never appear in chat logs or receipt

requirements.name: Bulk Operations
requirements.description: Scope and preview batches, canary first, individual idempotency keys, quotas, checkpoint per item and stop-on-error policy.
requirements.negative_case: partial success never reported as all success

requirements.name: Conversation Workflow Builder
requirements.description: Compile natural-language intent to a typed, reviewable DAG of certified operations, conditions, waits, triggers and compensation.
requirements.negative_case: prompt injection cannot create capabilities

requirements.name: History, Reconcile and Rollback
requirements.description: Maintain immutable redacted pre/post fingerprints, journal and supported per-provider compensation with unrecoverable disclosures.
requirements.negative_case: unknown commit state prohibits blind retry

requirements.name: Content and Media Studio
requirements.description: Draft posts, pages, tours/products and approved CPTs; native meta, taxonomy, relations, galleries, alt text, SEO and WPML parity.
requirements.negative_case: media rights and publish permission checked

requirements.name: Multi-site Command Center
requirements.description: Inventory many sites and stage policy/template diffs per site with isolation, per-site grants and rollback evidence.
requirements.negative_case: one-site grant does not grant another site

requirements.name: Approval and Delegation Center
requirements.description: Explain blast radius and Before/After, route to role owners, timebox exact plan hash and enforce dual-control where required.
requirements.negative_case: self-approval forbidden for segregated roles

requirements.name: Monitoring and Smart Alerts
requirements.description: Monitor drift, failures, expiration, performance and content changes with opt-in conditional alerts and deduplicated incident states.
requirements.negative_case: stale monitoring evidence cannot claim online

requirements.name: Staging to Production Promotion
requirements.description: Produce independently certified exact-source diffs and signed artifact plans; require separate production authority and test proof.
requirements.negative_case: staging approval never authorizes Production

requirements.name: Reusable Templates
requirements.description: Version signed form/workflow templates with semantic field mapping and compatibility migration; no hidden credential reuse.
requirements.negative_case: template cannot carry authority or secrets

requirements.name: Contextual Help and Troubleshooting
requirements.description: Explain each field, storage mapping, ownership, side effects, and next safe remediation from certified metadata.
requirements.negative_case: unknown behavior clearly labelled unknown

requirements.name: Self Diagnostics and Guided Recovery
requirements.description: Identify failing provider, schema, host, runtime, plugin and stored state; plan one fenced action with independent readback.
requirements.negative_case: disabled Host/Developer lane cannot silently execute

requirements.name: Conversation Intent and Session Continuity
requirements.description: Retain redacted draft intent and resumable form sessions with TTL, actor/site fencing and explicit confirmation on commit.
requirements.negative_case: old-session replay rejected

requirements.name: Dynamic Storage Adapter Registry
requirements.description: Register vendor/version-specific adapters that preserve plugin hooks, sanitizers and transactions; run conformance before writes.
requirements.negative_case: unrecognized table fails closed

requirements.name: Localization, RTL and Accessibility
requirements.description: Provide keyboard/screen-reader/RTL forms, accessible validation and localized terms without corrupting machine identifiers.
requirements.negative_case: missing labels and focus traps block

requirements.name: Workflow Quality and Usage Telemetry
requirements.description: Measure completion, abandonment, retries, latency and cost with redacted audit and tenant retention policies.
requirements.negative_case: no secret/value leakage in analytics

requirements.name: Policy and Data Governance
requirements.description: Pin issuer, subject, site UUID, origin, environment, source SHA, role, capability and data residency for every operation.
requirements.negative_case: cross-origin or stale source denies

requirements.name: Durable Cross-plugin Orchestration
requirements.description: Use saga/checkpoints, dependency DAG, compensating ops, independent readback, concurrency and crash recovery.
requirements.negative_case: no impossible global database atomicity promise

requirements.name: Drift and Lifecycle Management
requirements.description: Compare desired/actual options and deployed plugin changes; suspend stale adapters and queue human owner decisions.
requirements.negative_case: changed plugin schema invalidates stale form

requirements.name: Credential Lifecycle and Rotation
requirements.description: Manage expiry, least-privilege scopes, provider-bound rotation and zero-plaintext verification receipts.
requirements.negative_case: rotation never echoes old or new value

requirements.name: Event Trigger and Webhook Automation
requirements.description: Use authenticated event providers with signature, replay nonce, ordering and per-site rate limits.
requirements.negative_case: spoofed webhook never mutates

requirements.name: Commerce and Custom Object Integration
requirements.description: Support products, orders and arbitrary custom objects only through certified provider APIs and business validation hooks.
requirements.negative_case: payment/order side effects need distinct policy
